entries.name: Training Cup
entries.instructions: Enter Flick Rush at the tournament moogle. HD uses local tournament play; 3DS wireless play does not apply. Match roster: 1 Mog: Meow Wow; Hebby Repp; Komory Bat. Defend with a higher card total to evolve the first card; evolved value doubles. Switch Spirits to let the reserve reload. Published match-time scoring: 0:00–1:59 = 10, 2:00–2:22 = 9, 2:23–2:44 = 8, 2:45–3:07 = 7, 3:08–3:29 = 6, 3:30–3:52 = 5, 3:53–4:14 = 4, 4:15–4:37 = 3, 4:38–4:59 = 2, 5:00 or longer = 1; defeat = 0. Remaining HP scoring (use the highest matching threshold): 70% or more = 12, 60% or more = 11, 50% or more = 10, 45% or more = 9, 39% or more = 8, 34% or more = 7, 28% or more = 6, 23% or more = 5, 17% or more = 4, 12% or more = 3, 6% or more = 2, 1% or more = 1, 0% or more = 0. Successful attacks scoring (use the highest matching threshold): 90% or more = 12, 87% or more = 11, 83% or more = 10, 80% or more = 9, 76% or more = 8, 72% or more = 7, 69% or more = 6, 65% or more = 5, 61% or more = 4, 58% or more = 3, 54% or more = 2, 0% or more = 1. Blocks score one point each, capped at 5. Add time, HP, successful attacks and blocks: S at 30+, A at 23–29, B at 16–22, C at 15 or below. Cup prize scoring: S = 4, A = 3, B = 2, C = 1 point per round; sum the round points. Bronze 2+, Silver 3+, Gold 4+. These points are not spendable Medals.

entries.instructions: Enter Fountain Plaza after loading clear data to trigger the fight. Use Balloon spells and Curaga; Sora can use Superglide and Riku Dark Roll to evade. Defeat him separately for each character’s Ultima Weapon.

entries.name: Julius — Riku
entries.instructions: Enter Fountain Plaza after loading clear data to trigger the fight. Use Balloon spells and Curaga; Sora can use Superglide and Riku Dark Roll to evade. Defeat him separately for each character’s Ultima Weapon.

entries.name: Lord Kyroo
entries.summary: Shared timed encounter chain; damage persists as he escapes.
entries.instructions: Challenge Riku’s Nave, then Sora’s Promontory, then Riku’s Moonlight Wood; the sequence loops. After 70 seconds he escapes and retains remaining HP. Leaving the room mid-battle resets that attempt. Skipping Nave allows Riku to meet him at Moonlight Wood. The character delivering the final blow alone receives the HP bonus.
entries.prerequisites: Nave encounter is unavailable during the Square fire before Wargoyle.
entries.reward: Lord Kyroo Recipe, Link Accelerator, and HP bonus to the character who finishes the encounter.
entries.uncertainty: Source documents timeout and room-exit behavior; persistence across save reloads is not separately documented.

entries.name: Spirit creation
entries.summary: Extra materials improve creation rank and level; created ranks remain fixed.
entries.instructions: For a base ingredient quantity q, rank boosts +1/+2/+3/+4 require ceil(1.5q), 2q, 3q and 5q of that ingredient. For q=1, two pieces already give +2, three or four give +3, five give +4. Apply the smaller boost of the two ingredients; Risky Winds adds one further rank, capped at ★. Total materials grant ceil(total/3) bonus starting levels, capped at 20. Marked recipe-item formulas guarantee their intended breed. A donated command is consumed; Movement/Defense donations require retaining another copy. Exact command bonuses are recorded in the factual catalog.
entries.uncertainty: The source initial-level table contains inconsistent cells (average level 20 → 27; 30–01 range). Risky Winds describes a 50% odds change without clarifying relative versus percentage-point arithmetic. These defects prevent a certified level/odds optimizer.

entries.name: Spirit stats
entries.summary: Rank, breed, level and a creation-time random value determine base stats.
entries.instructions: Base stat × (rank correction + random value) × level correction ÷ 10. Rank corrections are ★1.18, A1.12, B1.06, C1, D0.94, E0.88 and F0.82. Random value ranges from (correction−1.1)/10 to (correction−0.9)/10. Level correction is 10+level through 50, then 35+level/2. Forecast adds further stat bonuses. Missing breed values stay unknown.

entries.name: HD training controls
entries.summary: Balloon, Water Barrel and Candy Goggles use HD controls.
entries.instructions: PS4 reference bindings: Balloon uses the touch pad to return balloons; good timing scores 3, early timing 1. Water Barrel uses L1/R1 flippers and L2/R2 jets; collect prizes before each pattern expires. Candy Goggles aims with the left stick: R1 fires red and L1 blue; match each Spirit’s request. Slow, medium and fast targets award 10, 20 and 30. Balloon gives affinity/EXP, Water Barrel EXP/LP, Candy Goggles affinity/LP. Paint Guns change appearance only. Treat consumption depends on happiness, food preference and Affinity Gain; uneaten treats are reconsidered every 3–7 seconds.
entries.uncertainty: PS4 control names are source labels. Steam keyboard and other-controller bindings are not documented by this source; use the configured on-screen prompts.

entries.name: Reality Shift
entries.summary: World-specific field and battle interactions use marked targets.
entries.instructions: HD PS4 activation is Triangle + Circle when a pink target appears. It pauses the action for the Shift. International layouts can also spend the selected deck command on activation, so choose it deliberately. Worlds use Slingshot (Traverse Town), Faithline (La Cité), Code Break (Grid), Bubble Burst (Prankster’s Paradise), Wonder Comic (Musketeers), Melody Catcher (Symphony), and Nightmare’s End/Mirage Split (The World That Never Was). Dreamline is a separate story crossing.
entries.uncertainty: Individual technique pages retain 3DS touch instructions and lack a complete Steam input crosswalk; no touch gestures are presented as PC controls.

entries.name: Secret ending
entries.summary: Another Guardian of Light is a separate Theater unlock.
entries.instructions: The published criteria require in-game trophies: Beginner 13, Standard 7, Proud 5, Critical 0. After Armored Ventus Nightmare, choose the answers about losing something important, close friends, and recovering something important. Beginner/Standard also need every golden credits letter. Replay credits through Mementos → Theater for another letter attempt; the ending appears in Theater instead of playing automatically.
entries.uncertainty: The page covers DDD and HD but does not independently document every HD retry combination after incorrect final answers; full recovery certification remains bounded.

entries.name: Clear data
entries.summary: Clear data opens Critical, Secret Portals, Julius and NG+.
entries.instructions: NG+ transfers Spirit instances and affinity, trophy shelf progress, Story, Glossary, Character Files and Mementos. Spirit levels and Ability Link boards reset; Game Records and Treasures reset. Keep the original clear save before beginning a new run.
